meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude 能输入 H&E 组织切片图像块（224x224、约20倍），输出每个查询基因的 log1p-CPM 空间表达值，覆盖约1.9万个人类蛋白编码基因，并可按基因符号查询。
howto.when: 当你需要从 H&E 切片得到空间基因表达、按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因，或要预测整张切片时触发。

say.text: 帮我对这张 H&E 切片预测 EPCAM 和 CD3D 的表达。
用 scgpt 源，对这批 224x224 组织块跑全转录组预测。
say.note: 会查询约1.9万个蛋白编码基因。

say.text: 把整张切片用 histolab 切块后，预测全转录组并生成 AnnData。
say.note: 需要先切块，再批量推理。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can take H&E tissue tiles (224x224, ~20x) and return log1p-CPM spatial expression per queried gene, covering a ~19k protein-coding gene panel queried by gene symbol.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need spatial gene expression from H&E slides, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol, or want whole-slide prediction after tiling.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D expression for this H&E slide.
say_en.note: Returns expression values per tile in log1p-CPM.

say_en.text: Run transcriptome-wide prediction on these 224x224 tiles with scgpt source.
Tile this slide with histolab, predict the transcriptome, and build an AnnData.
say_en.note: Requires tiling first, then batched inference.
